_comment: Provisional demonstration rules only. All priorities and review intervals must be verified by qualified solar engineers before operational use.

MultiByPassed.reason: Multiple bypass diodes activated — string-level shading or cell damage probable.
MultiByPassed.suggested_action: Physical inspection of affected string; check bypass diode continuity.
MultiByPassed.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

MultiDiode.reason: Multiple diode anomalies detected — potential diode failure across cells.
MultiDiode.suggested_action: Thermal re-inspection and I-V curve measurement recommended.
MultiDiode.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

MultiHotSpot.reason: Multiple hot-spots detected — elevated risk of cell damage or fire.
MultiHotSpot.suggested_action: Prioritise immediate ground inspection; isolate string if temperature differential is confirmed elevated.
MultiHotSpot.severity_note: Thermal pixel values in this dataset are grayscale renderings, not calibrated temperatures.

SingleByPassed.reason: Single bypass diode activated — localised shading or cell issue.
SingleByPassed.suggested_action: Schedule inspection within standard maintenance window; verify with I-V trace.
SingleByPassed.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

SingleDiode.reason: Single diode anomaly — isolated cell behaviour outside normal range.
SingleDiode.suggested_action: Note for next scheduled maintenance inspection.
SingleDiode.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

SingleHotSpot.reason: Single hot-spot detected — localised cell heating.
SingleHotSpot.suggested_action: Flag for next inspection cycle; monitor for progression.
SingleHotSpot.severity_note: Thermal pixel values in this dataset are grayscale renderings, not calibrated temperatures.

StringOpenCircuit.reason: Open-circuit condition detected — string likely offline, energy loss ongoing.
StringOpenCircuit.suggested_action: Immediate investigation; check wiring continuity and combiner-box connections.
StringOpenCircuit.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

StringReversedPolarity.reason: Reversed polarity detected — potential wiring fault; safety risk.
StringReversedPolarity.suggested_action: Immediate isolation and inspection by qualified electrician.
StringReversedPolarity.severity_note: Model confidence does not confirm severity; field verification required.

no_detection_message: No supported fault detected in this image.
no_detection_note: Absence of a detected fault does not confirm that the panel is healthy. The model may miss faults outside its training distribution.
disclaimer: All priorities, suggested actions, and review intervals are provisional demonstration rules generated from a single-session training dataset. They must not be used for operational maintenance decisions without verification by qualified personnel.
